Changes what FlamingoCode asks the model. A provider's own server-side rules still apply.
Plan + Build Limits
Configure caps for automatic planning and execution.

Per-Model Override
Auto = use project setting. On/Off = override for this specific model.
Diff Review
When enabled, agent file changes are shown as diffs for review before being applied.
Review changes before applying
Toggle OFF to auto-apply agent changes immediately (legacy behavior).
Atomic Batches
When ON, multiple file operations in one agent reply are reported as a single summary chip (files changed, lines, problems) instead of individual chips.
Compact summary mode
Report a single batch summary instead of per-file chips.
Prompt Enhancer
When ON, short prompts are automatically expanded into full build specs before sending. When OFF, use the ✨ button manually.
Auto-enhance short prompts
Automatically expand one-line prompts into detailed specs (goal, scope, files, acceptance checks).
Teach Mode
When ON, agent changes are explained in simple Bangla for non-coders. When OFF, no explanations shown.
Explain changes in Bangla
Show a teach panel with plain-language explanations after every agent change.
Inline Autocomplete
Show ghost-text code completions while typing. Suggestions come from the current file context and the Brain code graph. Tab accepts, Esc dismisses.
Enable autocomplete
Cursor-style ghost text completions in the editor.

Backup & Restore
⚠️
Sensitive Data Warning
The backup file contains ALL your data including:
  • All sessions (projects, files, chat history)
  • All providers including API keys
  • All agents and team configurations
  • All custom skill packs, plugin packs, and MCP servers
  • All settings (Uncensored Mode, diff review, autonomy, etc.)
  • All checkpoints and brain notes
Treat the backup file like a password database. Do not share it publicly or commit it to version control.
